data.long_description:
This exquisite 2-bedroom plus study apartment in Oceana Adriatic is now available for rent. Situated on a high floor, it offers stunning sunset views of the Royal Atlantis, creating a breathtaking living experience. The study has been thoughtfully converted into a spacious walk-in closet and vanity area, maximizing the functionality of the home.

Property Details:-

High Floor
Sunset view / Royal Atlantis 
2 Bedroom plus study
Study turned into a walk in closet and vanity area
Tastefully Furnished
Renovated

Fully renovated and tastefully furnished, this residence combines modern elegance with comfort, featuring high-quality finishes and stylish décor throughout. The open layout seamlessly connects living, dining, and kitchen areas, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining.

Enjoy access to world-class amenities and the vibrant lifestyle that Oceana Adriatic provides, including swimming pools, fitness facilities, and direct beach access.
